solution.play_surface: Public-safe live catalog projection plus permitted embed or approved watch-link fallback

obstacles.problem: YouTube OAuth testing expires and does not establish production readiness
obstacles.resolution: Separate test authorization, production verification and channel consent evidence

obstacles.problem: External writes can succeed without a received response
obstacles.resolution: Persist intent, serialize controllers and reconcile ambiguity without blind recreation

obstacles.problem: Mobile backgrounding, heat, audio routes and networks disrupt media
obstacles.resolution: Device-specific recording and recovery trials with explicit support boundaries

obstacles.problem: Chat/read traffic can exhaust shared quota
obstacles.resolution: Centralize observations, prefer server streaming, honor polling interval, budget per project and creator

obstacles.problem: Catalog/UI state can falsely imply a publicly live show
obstacles.resolution: Publish permitted provider observations with timestamps and an unknown state

obstacles.problem: Playback monetization, membership and provider data have distinct rules

rules: Independently authenticate principal, channel and consent at the backend
Reject changed intent under a reused request ID
Serialize writes per session and reject stale revisions
Persist intent before provider write and provider identity after observation
Treat unresolved create response as uncertain; never assume provider-side idempotency
Credential references require independent authorization and are never public bearer grants
